column1: # Altin Peak: the mine groans and the water seeps; every line leans on the collapse.

column3: We did it, {actor_name:1}!\nThe last beast is down.\nNow let's get out.{end_wait}
Why did the statues\nturn into monsters?{page_break}Were they protecting\nsomething down here?{end_now}
These carvings are\nolder than the mine.{page_break}Who built this room?{end_wait}
I've never seen stone\nworked like this.{page_break}Someone spent years\ncarving this chamber.{end_wait}
The statues stood here\nlong before the flood.{page_break}Perhaps they were\nguarding the ruins.{end_wait}
There's a chest\nbehind the statue.{page_break}The lid is damp,\nbut the lock is old.{end_wait}
The ruins and the\nwater beasts...{page_break}There must be a link.\nI just can't see it.{end_wait}
A dead end? After\nall that climbing?{page_break}Wait. Did you hear\nthe ceiling crack?{end_wait}
